_readme: Starts empty per context/features/phase-2-normalization-spec.md. Grows only when scripts/validate.py catches an ESPN player-ID inconsistency (the same real player showing up under two different IDs across seasons, or similar). Each override entry should record which player_ids it merges and why, e.g. { "player_id": 12345, "canonical_player_id": 12300, "_note": "..." }.
